scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w worker" "npm run dev -w frontend"

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w worker && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w worker && npm run build -w frontend
